purpose: Phase 1 browser cart state shared across storefront pages until SHRESTA-BE cart APIs are integrated.
businessRules: Persist only product IDs and quantities in browser storage.
Product names, prices, SKU, category, and images must be resolved from backend storefront product data before rendering.
Cart viewing remains public; login is required only before the final confirm-and-pay action.
Invalid persisted cart lines must be ignored and duplicate product IDs must be merged.
This module is a Phase 1 client continuity layer and must be replaced or reconciled with backend cart APIs when they exist.
